senses.definition: n.pr.f. (my delight is in her; cf. Ph. חפצבעל)—
mother of king Manasseh 2 K 21:1.
fig. name of Zion Is 62:4, here expl. by כִּי חפץ יהוה בָּךְ for Yahweh delighteth in thee.
